contentHtml:
Property management services in Newark

⚠️ Rent Control

Newark has rent control regulations. PPM handles compliance for all properties under management.

Tenant placement

We market your Newark rental across top listing platforms. Every applicant goes through income verification on the tenant’s share of the rent, a credit and rental history review, and background screening as New Jersey law allows.

Rent collection

Automated online collection with direct owner disbursements. Late fees handled per NJ law. Real-time visibility in your owner portal.

Maintenance coordination

24/7 tenant maintenance requests. Vendor network covering Essex County. Owners approve repairs above their stated threshold.

Financial reporting

Monthly owner statements and 24/7 portal access.

NJ compliance

PPM stays current on Newark and statewide NJ landlord-tenant law — security deposits, habitability, lease requirements, and eviction procedures.

The Newark rental market

Newark is New Jersey's largest city and the region's transit hub — NJ Transit and Amtrak at Newark Penn Station, PATH to Lower Manhattan, and light rail linking neighborhoods from the Ironbound to Forest Hill and University Heights. It is one of the state's most active rental markets, with steady demand from commuters, students, and hospital and university employees.

Much of the housing is two- to four-family and small multi-family, and Newark is a rent-control municipality — so screening, turnover speed, and staying current on the ordinance are what drive returns here.

Why Newark owners work with PPM

We market to Newark's deep renter pool and screen every applicant, run rent collection and maintenance through a Newark-area vendor network, and keep each property aligned with the city's rent-control rules and statewide NJ law — one flat fee, full visibility in your owner portal.

Newark has rent control.

Annual rent increases on covered buildings are capped by the city’s rent control ordinance, administered by the Newark Rent Control Board, and covered units must be registered. We keep every increase, notice, and registration compliant — and track the current cap and exemptions for you.
